title: Chicago Virginia bluebells
done: Virginia bluebells open pink and turn blue; the leaves fade by mid-summer.

steps.say: The young bluebell is really pink; we use purple. Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: 3 gaps, 3 green squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 green squares, a gap, a blue square, a gap, 2 green squares.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, 2 purple squares, a blue corner triangle in the bottom right, a blue square, a blue corner triangle in the bottom left, 2 blue squares.

Next row down, left to right: a purple corner triangle in the bottom right, a purple square, a purple corner triangle in the bottom left, 3 gaps, a blue corner triangle in the bottom right, a blue square, a blue corner triangle in the bottom left.
